summary: All 64 files in this work unit contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs related to completely monotone functions, Bernstein functions, Stieltjes functions, Laplace representations, Levy-Khinchine theory, and associated analysis. Every file has a module header, public imports, extensive mathematical documentation, and executable Lean declarations (def, theorem, lemma). None are pure import aggregators (FILTER-007) or empty of formal mathematics. All files advance the roadmap targets for completely monotone function theory and its connections to Bernstein/Stieltjes functions and Laplace transforms.

summary: Both files contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs — and advance roadmap targets. The first file establishes the characterization of Bernstein functions via complete monotonicity of their exponentials (Schilling et al., Theorem 3.7). The second extends the Gagliardo–Nirenberg–Sobolev inequality to integrable C¹ functions (Evans, §5.6.1). Neither is a pure import aggregator; both declare and prove original theorems in the TauCeti namespace with full mathematical documentation.
